title: AI vs 44 professions: does it win or tie against an expert? (GDPval)
source: OpenAI, GDPval (arXiv 2510.04374; GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.5 announcements) · articles.santismm.com/the-stopwatch-and-the-exam

scenes.text: AI versus 44 professions: lawyers, nurses, accountants. Who wins?
OpenAI measured it with GDPval: 1,320 real tasks, written by experts with about 14 years on the job.
Another expert compares two unsigned deliverables, the human's and the AI's, and picks blind.
In 2025, the best model won or tied on almost 48% of tasks. Parity is 50%.
Then OpenAI announced 71%, and in 2026, almost 85%. But those are the maker's own numbers.
But these tasks are well-defined, with full context, and one-shot. A job is much more.
The lesson: don't ask if AI passes an exam. Ask if it wins or ties with an expert on your tasks.
Because the most honest benchmark is the job a professional gets paid to do.
Save it, and share it with anyone who still measures AI with exams.
